critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:2030 build_site_config — only exposes a fixed allowlist of settings. Was missing `coins_comment_daily_cap_per_video`; fixed by this agent. Going forward, consider mirroring an explicit Pydantic SiteConfig response model so any new setting must be intentionally exported (catches this class of bug at type-check time).

/app/backend/server.py:1019-1035 comment-coin-cap logic uses `created_at` ISO string >= today's date string — works because ISO datetimes are lexicographically comparable, but is brittle. Prefer a typed datetime field or store a `day` discriminator. Also the cap semantics are ambiguous (count vs coin) — see action items.

/app/backend/server.py:299 _award_coins — non-atomic: increments user.coins then inserts ledger row separately. If the insert fails after the increment, coins are debited from the ledger's accountancy but already applied. Wrap in a Mongo transaction or invert (insert ledger first w/ a unique reason, then $inc) to make like-idempotency robust against retries.
/app/backend/server.py:780 like-coin idempotency uses reason='like:<video_id>' lookup — if reason format ever changes the ledger becomes stale; consider versioning the reason key.

Profile API GET /api/users/{id} email-visibility is correct, but be aware OWNER role and ADMIN role share `role='admin'` (per test_credentials.md) — therefore Owner sees every email. If 'Owner' was intended to be more restricted, that distinction is missing in the data model.

rca_of_the_issue: Real bug found: GET /api/site/config did not include `coins_comment_daily_cap_per_video` (build_site_config in server.py:2030 didn't list it). The setting was being PERSISTED correctly via PATCH /api/admin/settings (key-whitelist matched AppSettings.model_fields) but never read back by the frontend, which would cause the Admin Panel to lose the input value on reload AND the comment endpoint to fall back to the default (10) regardless of admin input. Fix: added one line to build_site_config to expose the field. Verified via test_settings_coin_keys_round_trip (now PASS).
